channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: OKX and ICE open tokenized securities venue with 113 assets
item.description: OKX and ICE opened a tokenized securities venue with 113 assets confirmed for phased listing, while 67 companies objected to share tokens, testing issuer control.

item.title: Polygon approvals on revokecash: Which network to choose?
item.description: How to revoke a Polygon approval on revokecash: choose Polygon PoS mainnet, chain ID 137, then confirm the revoke transaction with your wallet on Polygon.

item.title: Berachain bridge for beginners: what sets transfer speed
item.description: Is the Berachain bridge faster than Stargate? Not always: source-chain confirmations, route design and Stargate Taxi or Bus mode determine when assets arrive.

item.title: Swapping bridged ETH through SyncSwap on zkSync Era
item.description: To swap bridged ETH on zkSync Era, connect MetaMask, keep ETH for gas, choose your token, review the pool quote and minimum received, then sign and confirm.

item.title: How Many Confirmations Does a Token Swap Need? It Depends on the Chain
item.description: How many confirmations does a token swap need to be final? There is no universal count; the right milestone depends on the blockchain and how much certainty you need.

item.title: Does an ERC-20 Approval event show the current allowance?
item.description: Does an ERC-20 approval event show the current allowance? It records the value set by that transaction; read allowance(owner, spender) for today’s value.

item.title: Tether backs SCRYPT’s expansion into institutional payments
item.description: Tether invested in Swiss platform SCRYPT to support its move into third-party payments, extending stablecoin settlement toward fiat accounts for institutions.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2B in Binance hack crypto
item.description: The Justice Department won authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, part of a wider freeze exceeding $2.7 billion.

item.title: Should I speed up or cancel a stuck swap? Get past the nonce queue
item.description: Should you speed up or cancel a stuck DEX swap? Speed it up while the price stays within slippage; cancel and re-quote once it moves past minimum received.

item.title: Cancel a stuck swap transaction in MetaMask and keep your tokens
item.description: To cancel a stuck swap transaction in MetaMask, open Activity and approve a higher-fee replacement on its network while the swap is pending, then verify Cancelled.

item.title: How to Run an Ethereum Validator at Home With One 32 ETH Deposit
item.description: Run an Ethereum validator at home by syncing two clients, generating keys, depositing 32 ETH through the Staking Launchpad, and waiting for activation.

item.title: Slippage tolerance for insufficient output: retry safely
item.description: Slippage tolerance for an insufficient output amount error: refresh the quote, then raise the minimum-output allowance only enough for modest price movement.

item.title: How to reduce gas fees on DeFi loan repayments before you submit
item.description: How to reduce gas fees on DeFi loan repayments: compare network timing, approval options and fee settings, then confirm the debt change and record the receipt cost.

item.title: How Does an Optimistic Relay in MEV-Boost Use Collateral?
item.description: An optimistic relay in MEV-Boost serves a builder’s bid before simulation, then checks the block; collateral covers invalid delivery and limits proposer risk.

item.title: How to bridge ETH to zkSync Era and trade on SyncSwap
item.description: Bridge ETH from Ethereum to zkSync Era through the canonical bridge or a faster third-party route, verify the balance, then connect MetaMask to SyncSwap.

item.title: DOJ wins authority over $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds, while the broader recovery remains ongoing.

item.title: Bridged tokens from Sui: Reach an Ethereum exchange deposit
item.description: Move bridged tokens from Sui to an Ethereum exchange deposit address by returning supported assets to your wallet, then sending the accepted asset on Ethereum.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department obtained court authority over more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, while efforts to trace and freeze the wider theft continue.

item.title: Large Uniswap Swaps: Safer Routes for Deep and Thin Pools
item.description: To swap large amounts on Uniswap safely, check pool depth and price impact, set minimum output from the quote, then choose private routing or an auction.

item.title: Should I Call the Router or Pair Directly for Swaps?
item.description: Call the Uniswap V2 router for user-facing swaps; call a pair directly only when your contract transfers tokens atomically and checks output on every route.
